title: Hyblock Indicators on Chart

addMarkAreas.label: Distribution Zone — Whales Sell to Retail

edits.reason: Intro teaches 'Retail bullish + whales bearish = distribution; larger players are selling to retail buyers = likely price drop.' The 5 markPoints narrate the retail 75% long / whale net-short divergence (bars 6-9) but the distribution/supply ZONE itself is never drawn. A pink supply band across the top (104-108, inside the [76,108] band) where the divergence and 'Distribution! Retail Gets Rekt' (bar 9) occur visualizes the concept the chart is named after. Pink = supply/bearish per palette.

addMarkAreas.label: Accumulation Zone — Whales Buy from Retail

edits.reason: Lesson teaches 'Retail bearish + whales bullish = accumulation; larger players are buying from retail sellers = likely price rise.' markPoints narrate retail 80% short / whale net-long divergence (bars 6-9) at the bottom but the demand/accumulation ZONE is never drawn. A teal demand band across the bottom (77-82, inside the [77,124] band) where 'Accumulation! Retail Gets Rekt' (bar 9) sits before the rally to 124 mirrors the intro's distribution band. Teal = demand/bullish per palette.
